audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's level chart contradicts the content layer on all seven rows: full reads Xerath/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill, content (and packet) read Orianna then Xerath six times. Row 0 is exactly backwards.
audit.why: 43.56% over 2018 games with a 1050-range stun and 1000-range W against Orianna's 815 ball supports Xerath owning every row from level 2. Level 1 is Orianna's because none of his poke is online yet.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Orianna; phases[1..6].side -> Xerath, each why rewritten to state the range/cooldown reason he owns that row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].why described an Orianna power spike (Lost Chapter, level 6, Luden's) in a lane the data says she loses, and the level-6 row claimed her presence doubles.
audit.why: At 6 the spike that matters is Rite of the Arcane (130/115/100s, 5000 range), not Command: Shockwave (110/95/80s, 410 radius) — his ult reaches across the map and hers does not reach him.
audit.corrected: Rows 4, 5 and 6 now name his spikes and what yours can and cannot answer; the late row keeps the one real opening — he is immobile while ulting.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text calls his ultimate 'Rite of the Ancients' and 'global artillery'; whys[4] also says 'R global'. breakdown.cooldowns held no numbers at all.
audit.why: The kit's name is Rite of the Arcane and its range is 5000 — long, but not global, and Riot's text says it immobilises Xerath for the duration. Shocking Orb is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s at 1050; Arcanopulse 9->5s; Eye of Destruction 14->10s at 1000. Orianna's answers are Q 815, E 9s, R 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Name fixed to Rite of the Arcane, 'global' replaced with the 5000 range, and breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt on the real stun and ult cooldowns plus his immobility while channelling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d carried the Shocking Orb line under ball-placement and auto-weave titles, and dontsFull[2].d carried the tradeBad string under a Shockwave title.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten against its own title, using his 1050 stun range and your 815 Q as the concrete constraint.

edits.after: His range holds up in fights, but he is immobile — hold R for a flank onto him once Shocking Orb is on its 11s cooldown.

edits.after: Xerath wins by stunning you from 1050, chaining Q and W poke, and shelling you off the map with a 130s ultimate.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. It governs your forward steps. - E Command: Protect spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb: 13s at rank 1, 11s at rank 5 and 1050 range — his only CC; dodge it and the artillery never converts. Step up on its downtime. - Rite of the Arcane: 130s at rank 1 — he is immobile the whole time. - Your E is 9s: save it for the stun follow-up.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — Xerath is immobile while he shells, so a flank Shockwave that catches him mid-rotation ends the fight before his team gets damage.

edits.before: His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Bait it, count it, then go.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.

edits.before: His Rite of the Ancients (R) is global artillery and his E is a long-range stun that sets it up. You have zero pick pressure back at this range, so hold your ball as a shield and dodge sideways on his E - eating the stun means eating his entire poke rotation plus a jungler.
edits.after: His Rite of the Arcane (R) fires from 5000 range and his E is a 1050 stun that sets it up. You have zero pick pressure back at this range, so hold your ball as a shield and dodge sideways on his E - eating the stun means eating his entire poke rotation plus a jungler.

notes: phases[N].rating left untouched — the polarity of that number is not derivable from the data, and the row sides were the demonstrable defect. Xerath's Arcanopulse is listed at 750 range in the kit (the charged maximum is not in Riot's text), so no claim was made that his Q out-ranges your 815 ball; the W at 1000 and E at 1050 carry that point instead. breakdown.wave and breakdown.mid are Orianna-generic templates with no Xerath content; a grounded rewrite did not fit the length band without dropping real wave advice, so they were left in place.
